text:
Anya: draft of relnotes is up in the PR — we need a short blurb about the embeddings streaming deprecation and the Go SDK snippet migration. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 :eyes:
Sam: thanks, added a rough paragraph but don't want to bury the workaround for Dedicated users. there's a known issue with older dedicated clusters hitting timeouts when large batches + streaming are used. We should flag it under 'known issues'.
June: Agreed. Can we be specific about the workaround? customers will ask.
Marcos: propose wording: 'If you see streaming timeouts on Dedicated prior to runtime v0.9.0, set REDWOOD_EMBED_BATCH=1 or pin to a non-streaming variant (model@no-stream) until your fleet is upgraded.' short and actionable.
Anya: that wording is good. Also need a short migration example for Go — the old snippet used Embeddings.Stream, new SDK uses Embeddings.Generate with streaming callbacks. I can paste a minimal snippet.
Sam: paste it inline, but keep it <= 8 lines. We display both old and new so users can grep their code.
Anya: ```go
// old
resp, _ := client.Embeddings().Stream(ctx, input)
// new
client.Embeddings().Generate(ctx, input, func(chunk EmbeddingChunk){
  fmt.Println("got chunk", chunk.Vector[:3])
})
```
June: can we also add a quick note on token accounting? streaming embeddings currently don't count some interim tokens in the UI; mention it's being fixed in analytics v2.
Marcos: put that in 'known issues' too: 'Analytics token accounting may underreport streaming embeddings; full reconciliation in analytics v2 (ETA: next week)'.
Anya: done. One more: a few doc pages reference the old query param `stream=true` in examples (search + embeddings). I opened a tiny PR to replace with the new streaming param shape. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4571
Sam: CI flagged linkcheck failures on the migration guide — two internal anchors changed. CI log: 
```
LinkCheck: /docs/sdk/go#migration -> 404 anchor not found
LinkCheck: /docs/reference/embeddings#streaming -> 404
```
Marcos: I'll fix anchors in the Go page and add redirects. Also add a comment in the PR explaining why anchors were renamed so linkcheck doesn't auto-revert.
June: can we surface the relnote in the product announcement doc too? small paragraph under 'platform changes' — marketing will reuse that.
Anya: yup. I'll update the announcement draft after this thread.
ci-bot: build succeeded for docs/pr-4567 (checklink + lint) — 2 warnings: anchor-typo, example-lint.
Sam: noted. who will handle the example-lint? I can trim the snippet lines and remove trailing spaces.
Marcos: I'll take the anchor fixes and add redirect entries to _redirects.yaml.
Anya: plan: Sam trims snippet + push; Marcos fixes anchors & redirects + push; I merge relnotes text into the relnotes branch and update the announcement draft. target: ship with tomorrow's deploy.
June: thanks all. small ask — add a one-liner at top of relnotes: 'breaking: streaming embeddings deprecated in favor of Generate-based API; see migration notes'. keeps the signal strong.
Anya: added that bolded line. PR ready for final pass. @Sam @Marcos please thumbs when done :thumbsup:
Sam: done. pushed new snippet (no trailing spaces). :thumbsup:
Marcos: pushed anchors + redirect, left a short commit note. :white_check_mark:
Anya: merging in 10 if no objections.
June: no objections from product side.
ci-bot: merged branch docs/relnotes-streaming-deprecate into main (commit 9f3a2).
Anya: relnotes live. I'll follow up with a small support FAQ doc linking the workaround.
Sam: can we add an internal note for SEs about Dedicated clusters and upgrading schedules? I'll draft and ping platform-ops.
Marcos: good call. I'll include the minimal k8s rollout command we recommend.
Anya: perfect. closing thread.
